title: NeoPhylo exercise file
description: Lesson/exercise file format, schema v2, v3 and v4 (v1.1 design spec section 3.6, v1.4 spec section 4, v1.4b spec section 4). This schema mirrors the validation in crates/neophylo-core/src/exercise.rs: unknown properties are ignored, `locked` and `prompts` are optional, sim.kappa is required when sim.model is "K80" or "F84", and analysis.kappa is allowed only when analysis.correction is "K2P_PHYLIP". `summary` is required only here — the engine ignores it — because repository lessons power the app's Lessons menu. Schema_version 2, 3 and 4 validate here — the engine still accepts v1 files (migrated on load) so old links keep working, but repository exercise files are v2 or later. The v3 identifiers (analysis.kappa, corrections "F84"/"K2P_PHYLIP", sim.model "F84", sim.base_freqs) are valid only with schema_version 3 or later; the v4 identifiers (analysis.site_filter, correction "Poisson") are valid only with schema_version 4. Numeric fields follow the engine's effective ranges (sim.length 10..=10000, sim.seed 0..=2^53-1, at_step 0.., site_filter.cutoff_pct 0..=100). Model/alphabet compatibility, embedded-FASTA character validity, reference label matching, the F84 base-frequencies sum-to-1 rule and the F84 kappa feasibility floor are semantic checks the engine performs; this schema only covers structure.

summary.description: One-line lesson description shown in the app's Lessons menu. A display field the engine ignores (unknown properties pass through loadExercise).

newick.description: Newick string for the reference tree; its leaf labels must equal the alignment's labels (checked by the engine).

locked.description: Dotted control paths fixed for the lesson, e.g. "sim.model".

bootstrap.description: v1.2 spec 7.1: the lesson's own bootstrap settings — the panel's initial replicates and seed. Absent means the app defaults (100 replicates, seed 1).

objectives.description: The lab's learning objectives, listed on the index and the lab page.

handout_md.description: The student handout in markdown, rendered by the lab page (never as raw HTML).

settings.description: One row per PHYLIP option: its PHYLIP default and the matching NeoPhylo setting.

phylip_note_md.description: The "what PHYLIP's outfile showed you vs what NeoPhylo shows you" note, in markdown.

chain.description: The PHYLIP programs the lab reproduces, in order (e.g. dnadist → neighbor).

lab.description: v1.4 spec 6.2: optional lab-pack block. Absent on ordinary exercises; a file under exercises/labs/ without it is refused at load by the lab registry.

baseFreqs.description: v1.4 spec 4: F84 instructor-set base frequencies in A, C, G, T order (each positive; must sum to 1 — the engine checks the sum). Allowed only with sim.model "F84".

kappa.description: v1.4 spec 4: the K2P_PHYLIP transition/transversion ratio (default 2.0 when omitted). Only valid with correction "K2P_PHYLIP".

cutoff_pct.description: MEGA's site-coverage cutoff: a column counts when this percentage of sequences is not missing there. Required for kind "partial"; not allowed otherwise.

siteFilter.description: v1.4b spec 4/3.1: MEGA's gap treatment applied to the alignment before distances (schema_version 4 only). Absent means pairwise deletion — the pre-v1.4b behavior.

v3Identifiers.description: v1.4 spec 4: the new identifiers exist only in schema_version 3 files. In a v2 file an F84/K2P_PHYLIP correction, analysis.kappa, sim.model "F84" and sim.base_freqs are invalid.

v4Identifiers.description: v1.4b spec 4: the v4 identifiers exist only in schema_version 4 files. In a v2 or v3 file an analysis.site_filter key (even a null one) and the correction "Poisson" are invalid.

true_tree.description: Newick string; every non-root node must carry a branch length. Syntax is checked by the engine, not by this schema.

fasta.description: Aligned FASTA text embedded in the lesson; it must parse and its characters must be valid under the declared alphabet (checked by the engine).

at_step.description: 1-based number of the join being discussed. The prompt appears at stepper position at_step-1, where that join is still the pending join; one past the last join (at_step = steps+2 for NJ, steps+1 for UPGMA) shows on the completed tree. A predict_pair must never target NJ's final three-way join — there is no pair to predict.

at.description: v1.2 spec 7.1: a predict_branch prompt is anchored to the bootstrap panel with "at": "bootstrap" instead of at_step; it shows when the 'How sure are we?' panel first shows.

reveal.description: Optional explanation a predict_pair card shows only after the student picks (e.g. why the closest pair is not the answer); must not spoil the question.

reveal_pair.description: Optional pair of taxon labels: the answered prompt card shows a "Show a vs b" button opening the pair-detail panel, and the next step's explanation keeps a "Revisit" link. Both labels must be alignment taxon names — checked by the engine at load, not by this schema.

after.description: bootstrap-basics round 3: optional sequencing trigger on a bootstrap-stage note. The note stays hidden until its trigger — "first_run": the first completed bootstrap run; "continue_or_second_run": a second completed run or a Continue on the first_run note; "longer_run": a completed run on a longer alignment (Length >= 3,000) or a Continue on the continue_or_second_run note. Once shown it stays.
